title: Commercial Driver's License Standards; Knowledge Test Translation and Interpreter Use
reason: Proposed change to how States administer CDL knowledge tests in other languages.

citations.quote: States would be required to use translations approved by the State driver licensing agency

assessment: State driver licensing agencies would need approved translations of CDL knowledge tests and would have to stop allowing interpreters during the test. Comments close December 8, 2026.

title: Minimum Standards for Driver's Licenses and Identification Cards Acceptable by Federal Agencies for Official Purposes; Mobile Driver's Licenses
reason: Extends the period Federal agencies may accept mobile driver's licenses from States holding a waiver.

citations.quote: extend the period during which Federal agencies may accept mobile driver's licenses issued by States that hold a temporary waiver

assessment: States with a temporary mDL waiver keep Federal acceptance for longer; waiver requirements are unchanged. Effective November 9, 2026.

title: National Highway Performance Program; Vehicle Registration Data Sharing Pilot

citations.quote: Participation is voluntary, and no record identifying a vehicle owner would be shared.
